name: reply-translate
description: Adds translate buttons under Claude's final reply of each turn

languages.title: Target languages
languages.description: Languages to translate into, comma-separated: tags such as zh-CN, zh-TW, en, ja, or names. Each gets a button under the reply, in this order, except the reply's own language. auto: the language the buttons are drawn in, then English

primaryLanguage.title: Main language
primaryLanguage.description: Your own language, such as zh-CN: as each turn ends, its final reply is translated into it in the background when the reply is in another language, so the translation is ready when you press (one model call per such reply). It also comes first among the targets. Empty: off

autoExpand.title: Open main-language translations by themselves
autoExpand.description: Needs a main language. true: a final reply in another language is translated into the main language as its turn ends and the translation opens by itself, with a progress bar while it runs; false: it is translated in the background and opens when you press

uiLanguage.title: Button language
uiLanguage.description: Language of the buttons: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system language; or a tag such as zh-CN, en, ja

replaceOriginal.title: Show translations in place of the reply
replaceOriginal.description: true: an open translation, in any language, takes the place of the reply, so the reply shows in one language at a time, and Original shows it as written again. With a main language set, a final reply in another language is also translated into it as its turn ends, with no press; false: translations show under the reply

skipPrimaryReplies.title: No buttons on replies in the main language
skipPrimaryReplies.description: Needs a main language. true: a final reply already in the main language is left as it is, with no buttons and no room kept for them, unless it has a translation open already

alwaysShowButtons.title: Always show the buttons
alwaysShowButtons.description: true: the buttons always show under each final reply; false: on the desktop they show only while the pointer is over the reply

translateAll.title: Translate all of Claude's text
translateAll.description: true: the notes Claude writes between tool calls while it works are translated too, not only its final reply of each turn. The notes get no buttons of their own: the buttons under the turn's final reply act on the whole turn. With a main language set, each note in another language is translated as the tool call after it starts, one model call each; false: only the final replies

controlRange.title: Replies the band above the prompt acts on
controlRange.description: A row above the prompt puts this many of the latest final replies in one language at once, or back as written; a reply with no translation into that language yet costs one model call. 0: no row

model.title: Translation model
model.description: Model alias or id used for the translation

showTokens.title: Show token counts
showTokens.description: true: each translation says how many tokens it took, every call that made it counted, a second try included: in the mark at its end in the reply's place, else in its heading. The row above the prompt ends with the tokens all of the session's translations have taken so far, failed ones included; false: no counts

markPosition.title: Where a translation in place says so
markPosition.description: With replaceOriginal, where a translation in the reply's place says what it was translated from (and, with showTokens, the tokens it took). end: in italics at the end of its last line; below: in small type on a line of its own under it
